shared_elements: coarse weathered stone surface worked in shallow relief/incision
horizontally banded division of the surface
raised/recessed border framing the worked area
justification: Both present a tall vertical stone field whose decoration is organised in stacked horizontal registers within a framed, slightly recessed panel, and both are heavily weathered coarse stone worked in shallow relief. Beyond that generic correspondence they differ fundamentally: A is a flat rock-cut panel filled with rows of fine linear script-like marks with no figural content, while B is a free-standing shaped monolith with an anthropomorphic silhouette and bold curvilinear motifs including discs and arcs.
